name: Kristine White
description: Kris is our 'tresorier extraordinaire' who manages the finances as well as being involved in many other areas of the organisation.

name: Rita Thakur
description: Rita is our fearless leader, taking on the challenges of the Alliance Francaise with skill and passion.

name: Margaret Frances
description: Margaret is responsible for dotting the i's and crossing the t's - a task which she does with aplomb.

name: Geoff Galagher
description: Geoff is as passionate about French as most of us are about cakes. Despite being an Aussie, he is a Francophile through and through.

name: Catherine Thornberry
description: Catherine is our native French Belgian who loves to share her language and culture with her students.

name: David Tanner
description: If there is an event to happen, David is making it happen. Any great idea you might have, please pass them to David or Lesley.

name: Lesley McCulloch
description: Lesley is one of our long time contributors, with a history in journalism and a passion for French language and culture. Lesley is also one of our events coordinators.
